scripts.label: Explanation finding pin defenders no recapture
scripts.text: The capture works because the defenders are pinned to their king and cannot recapture there. The shown line has a material gain.

scripts.label: Explanation finding pin collected
scripts.text: The piece is pinned to its king and can only move along the pin line. It is lost in the shown continuation.

scripts.label: Explanation finding skewer collected
scripts.text: When the front piece moves, the piece behind it is captured along the same line in this continuation.

scripts.label: Explanation finding king skewer collected
scripts.text: The check makes the king move out of the line. The same attacking piece then captures the target behind it in the saved continuation.

scripts.label: Explanation finding sole defender captured
scripts.text: The capture removes the target's only defender. That target is captured next in the verified continuation.

scripts.label: Explanation finding deflection collected
scripts.text: The reply moves the defender away, leaving its target undefended. That target is captured next in the shown continuation.

scripts.label: Explanation finding discovered capture
scripts.text: Moving the blocker opens another piece's attacking line. That piece captures the target along the opened line in the shown continuation.

scripts.label: Explanation finding discovered check
scripts.text: The moving piece gets out of the way and uncovers check from another piece.

scripts.label: Explanation finding double check
scripts.text: Two pieces give check at the same time in this continuation. Both attacking lines give check together.

scripts.label: Explanation finding double attack collected
scripts.text: The moved piece attacks one target while the opened line attacks another. The attack along that opened line wins material in the shown continuation.

scripts.label: Explanation finding promotion material retained
scripts.text: The pawn promotes in this continuation, and the shown line retains a material gain.

scripts.label: Explanation finding undefended capture gain
scripts.text: The continuation captures an undefended piece and retains a net material gain for the capturing side.

scripts.label: Explanation finding relative pin released
scripts.text: The opponent's previous move broke a relative pin on the attacking piece. The next move left the target there, and it is captured in the shown line.

scripts.label: Game explanation legal reply
scripts.text: The other side can play the reply shown on the board. Follow that move to examine the continuation.

scripts.label: Explanation cue hanging piece
scripts.text: Before moving, check which of your pieces can be captured without a useful recapture.

scripts.label: Explanation cue missed tactical capture
scripts.text: Look for loose enemy pieces before choosing a quiet move.

scripts.label: Explanation cue fork
scripts.text: Check forcing moves that attack two valuable targets at once.

scripts.label: Explanation cue pin
scripts.text: Before moving a pinned piece, check what it exposes: your king or a more valuable piece.

scripts.label: Explanation cue skewer
scripts.text: Watch for an attack that exposes another valuable piece behind the first target.

scripts.label: Explanation cue removing defender
scripts.text: Before exchanging a defender, check what it currently protects.
